newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, Germany reach powerplant deal.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, Germany reach powerplant deal.

text.p: Croatian electricity board (HEP) and German RWE Energie electric company agreed on Saturday to form a joint venture to finance the completion of a big thermo-electric plant in Croatia.

State daily Vjesnik said on Sunday RWEE would initialy invest 50 million German marks into the Plomin 2 powerplant. It would later provide another 200 million marks, obtained thhrough loans on the international financial market.
The final value of the joint venture, located on the Adriatic Istrian peninsula, should ammount to 500 million marks, the daily said.
The Plomin 2, designed to reach the annual production of 1.3 billion kw/h is supposed to pay off the RWEE by supplying it with electricity at a fixed price for a 15 year period.
After that the plant would be fully owned by HEP.
